concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-reporting-grant-api-report]] - limited-release beta Grant API report for recipient transaction count and volume grouped by currency, with OAuth-consent visibility and Control Panel execution boundaries
warnings: Preserve both qualifications: the report is labeled Beta, and the Grant API is stated to be in limited release.
Preserve the OAuth-consent condition on recipient visibility; do not interpret a missing recipient as proof of no Grant API activity.
Keep this Control Panel report distinct from API grant/revoke operations, webhook notifications, and reconciliation guarantees.
